keys.description: Animate the live-agent widget while a child waits on the lead; false shows a steady highlight instead.
Consecutive goal-loop reminders with no tool call before the loop force-stops.
Milliseconds the goal loop waits after the lead settles before it re-evaluates and sends the next reminder; also the wait before an unstarted wake is retried.

Context-usage percent at which the lead is advised to compact at its next safe boundary, and the reference shown in goal reminders. Interim context reminders are sent at a run boundary one and two thirds of the way from here to compaction_hard_percent; at or above compaction_hard_percent, neither the advisory nor the reminders fire.
Context-usage percent at which the lead is steered into compaction preparation at the next tool-call boundary.
Context-window size in tokens used for the context-usage percent; 0 uses the model's own window.
UTF-8 byte budget for the dialog section of the lead compaction summary: user messages, the lead's replies, and one line per tool call, newest first.
UTF-8 byte budget for the required re-reads the lead compaction summary inlines, taken smallest first; entries that do not fit are listed for the revived lead to read first.
Days since a spawned child's last activity before its stored home is pruned at lead startup; 0 disables age pruning.

Model that writes short summaries of collapsed tool and message rows in the lead's terminal view, as provider/model-id (split at the first /, for example openai/gpt-5-mini); empty turns summaries off. It signs in through the provider's existing authentication. Enabling it sends the lead conversation and tool and message content to that provider. Summaries use the workflow.lang language, or the language the user writes in when that is unset.

Thinking level for the display-summary model, clamped to the levels the model supports. off (or a level the model clamps to off) sends no thinking setting: most providers then disable thinking, and some (for example openai-codex) use their server default.
